items.headline: OpenAI secures $11 billion in fresh funding at $1.25 trillion valuation
items.summary: Bloomberg reported OpenAI closed roughly $11 billion as a first close of a larger round that could reach $20 billion, with the valuation coming in below an earlier $1.4 trillion target. It underscores investors' continued appetite for AI despite a broader tech selloff the same week.

items.headline: AI stock selloff wipes out $1.44 trillion as Nvidia falls 8.9%
items.summary: A dozen major AI-linked stocks lost about $1.44 trillion in market value in a single session, with Nvidia posting its worst daily close since January 2025, as investors reassessed AI spending and valuations following the US midterm elections.

items.headline: Shield AI to acquire radar maker Echodyne in $5.3 billion deal
items.summary: Defense-tech firm Shield AI agreed to buy counter-drone radar company Echodyne for up to $5.3 billion, funded in part by a new $1 billion Series H round valuing Shield AI at $28.8 billion, as it expands from autonomous aircraft into radar and counter-UAS systems.

items.headline: Zipline raises $1.5 billion at $21.5 billion valuation to scale US drone delivery
items.summary: Drone-delivery startup Zipline closed a $1.5 billion round, nearly tripling its valuation from earlier in the year, alongside a new multi-year deal with Walmart to add 300 drone delivery sites across the US.

items.headline: Humble Robotics raises $51 million to build cabless, driverless electric freight trucks
items.summary: The startup, founded by an ex-Apple and Uber self-driving veteran, raised a Series A led by Obvious Ventures to move its cabless 'Humble Hauler' autonomous electric trucks into customer pilots for port drayage and warehouse runs.

items.headline: OpenAI to cut off Cursor's access to its models after SpaceX acquisition
items.summary: OpenAI notified SpaceX it will wind down direct model access for the AI coding tool Cursor around November 12, citing concerns about how its technology would be used under SpaceX ownership; Cursor will still offer Grok, Anthropic, and Google models.

items.headline: Meta rolls out Wonder-trained models to Muse and Meta AI users
items.summary: Meta began pushing models trained using its 'Wonder' technique out to its Muse assistant and the broader Meta AI product, part of the company's push to catch up with OpenAI and Google in consumer AI features.

items.headline: Report: Google nearing Gemini 4 launch before end of 2026
items.summary: Google DeepMind is reportedly in the final stages of polishing Gemini 4 and aims to ship it well before year-end, after earlier shifting resources toward faster Flash-tier models and delaying a planned Gemini 3.5 Pro release.

items.headline: OpenAI pitches mandatory AI 'speed limits' to Congress in post-midterm policy push
items.summary: Timed to the lame-duck congressional session, OpenAI is proposing mandatory safeguards on the most powerful AI systems, which it is branding as 'speed limits,' while also trying to rebrand data centers as 'AI compute campuses' to ease local opposition.

items.headline: OpenAI says ChatGPT's search-style query volume has reached about one-fifth of Google's
items.summary: ChatGPT's consumer product lead said ChatGPT now handles roughly 20% as many search-like queries as Google, a self-reported metric that highlights AI chatbots' growing role as an alternative to traditional web search.

items.headline: Senior DeepSeek researcher warns rapid AI progress could disrupt workforce within a decade
items.summary: A DeepSeek researcher cautioned that fast-moving AI capability gains could trigger significant labor-market disruption and structural problems for startups within the next five to ten years, adding a note of caution from inside a leading AI lab.

items.headline: Kodiak AI nears completion of driverless trucking safety case ahead of IKEA launch
items.summary: Kodiak AI said its safety case for fully driverless freight trucking is about 99% complete, as the company works toward a planned end-of-2026 launch of driver-out operations for retail partner IKEA.
